death.printed_wreck: You're printed fresh at the {stations:manufactory|lower}. Your wreck lies near ({x}, {y}). It will crumble in {minutes} minutes.
death.wreck_crumbled: Your wreck has crumbled, and everything in it is gone.
reconfigure.not_here: You can only be reconfigured at the {stations:manufactory|lower}.
reconfigure.done: The {stations:manufactory|lower} whirs and reprints your plating. Looking good.
mech.no_blueprint: The gantry has no blueprint loaded. {npcs:foreman} knows where one is.
mech.console_no_blueprint: No blueprint loaded. {npcs:foreman} should know where one is.
mech.complete: The {mech|lower} is complete! {player} installed the last part. {npcs:foreman} wants to power it up.
mech.not_powered: It hasn't been powered up yet. {npcs:foreman} wants to be there when it wakes.
mech.powered_up: {player} and {npcs:foreman} power up the {mech|lower}. Its visor lights up, and it stands. Deploy it from the gantry console.
mech.recalled: The gantry winches the {mech|lower} back onto its pad.
mech.clamped: It's clamped to the gantry. Deploy it from the console to take it out to the {area}.
mech.destroyed: The {mech|lower} has been destroyed! Its {kept} survive; the rest has to be rebuilt.
mech.only_mechs_hurt: Your attack glances off its hide. Only a mech can hurt it.
hab.bed_empty: The bed is empty. Seeds come from the specimen plants in the {area:quiet_reach}.
hab.set_done: {player} finished the hab's {set|lower}! The hab feels cosier (+{comfort} comfort).
hab.rested: You feel rested. +{bonus}% XP for the next {minutes} minutes.
hab.too_bare: The hab's a bit bare to really rest in (comfort {comfort} of {needed}). More furniture would help.
hab.trophy_wall_bare: The trophy wall is bare. Trophies come from tough fights: {trophies}...
quest.lost_items: Hang on, you're missing something {quest} needs. Your journal flips back a page.
